description: Voyager moves into stranger territory where temporal fractures, the Q Continuum, former Borg and unfamiliar civilizations broaden the journey before the first confrontation with Species 8472 changes everything.

s03e01.description: The stranded crew struggles to survive while the Doctor, Paris and Suder mount separate efforts to retake Voyager from the Kazon.

s03e02.description: Tuvok's suppressed memory sends him and Janeway into events aboard the Excelsior during Captain Sulu's confrontation with the Klingons.

s03e03.description: Paris and Kim are imprisoned with neural devices that provoke aggression while Voyager searches for the hidden penal complex.

s03e04.description: Voyager crosses territory claimed by a hostile swarm species while the Doctor's program begins suffering catastrophic memory loss.

s03e05.description: Voyager finds two Ferengi from an earlier wormhole exploiting a primitive world by posing as divine figures.

s03e06.description: B'Elanna experiences vivid memories of an elderly passenger's youth and uncovers a suppressed genocide hidden beneath a peaceful society.

s03e07.description: Janeway submits to ritual tests she considers irrational to save Kes after a mysterious shrine leaves her near death.

s03e08.description: Voyager is thrown to 1996 Earth and discovers a technology magnate whose stolen future technology threatens the timeline.

s03e09.description: Janeway's crew races to stop Starling from entering the future while navigating 20th-century Los Angeles and a stranded time traveler.

s03e10.description: Kes is possessed by the consciousness of a dead tyrant who uses her body and powers to reclaim political control.

s03e11.description: Q asks Janeway to bear his child as a civil war inside the Continuum begins spilling into ordinary space.

s03e12.description: Janeway and the Doctor return to a darkened Voyager overrun by giant airborne organisms from an alien virus.

s03e13.description: Neelix fears becoming useless as Voyager leaves familiar territory and becomes involved in a criminal exchange at a trading station.

s03e14.description: Kim falls for a holodeck character who turns out to be controlled by a lonely alien with dangerous access to Voyager.

s03e15.description: Janeway repeatedly experiences her own death while an alien presence tries to convince her to surrender and leave her body.

s03e16.description: A Vulcan mating condition transmitted to B'Elanna unleashes intense aggression and desire during an away mission.

s03e17.description: Chakotay encounters former Borg drones trying to recreate a limited collective consciousness to stabilize their divided colony.

s03e18.description: The Doctor's attempt to improve his personality accidentally creates a violent alter ego that endangers Kes and the crew.

s03e19.description: Neelix and Tuvok are trapped in an orbital tether with refugees while investigating asteroid attacks that may be deliberate.

s03e20.description: Kim is drawn toward a society of women who claim he belongs to their species, but their welcoming story conceals a lethal reproductive cycle.

s03e21.description: Kes begins living her life backward through time, revealing a possible future and clues to an approaching Krenim conflict.

s03e22.description: The Doctor creates a holographic family whose unreal perfection is challenged when B'Elanna rewrites the program to include genuine hardship.

s03e23.description: A Voth scientist proves his reptilian species evolved on Earth, but his discovery collides with a doctrine that forbids their true origin.

s03e24.description: Voyager's crew members vanish one by one as aliens replace them and transfer the humans to a distant habitat.

s03e25.description: A Maquis mutiny holoprogram becomes dangerous when Seska's old modifications trap Tuvok and Paris inside the unfinished story.

s03e26.description: Voyager enters Borg space and discovers the Collective is losing a devastating war against Species 8472.
